description: Source code for a device driver supporting Philips Hue lights, including device discovery, configuration, resource management, and monitoring.

methods.name: philipsHueDeviceDriverInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Philips Hue device driver, setting up callbacks and supported device classes.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Starts monitoring configured bridges and initializes device list.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Stops monitoring bridges, cleans up resources, and deallocates driver.

methods.name: bridgeFoundCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new bridge is discovered; adds it to pending list and signals device found.

methods.name: discoverStart
methods.description: Begins device discovery process for Philips Hue bridges.

methods.name: pendingBridgeFreeFunc
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a pending bridge structure.

methods.name: discoverStop
methods.description: Stops device discovery process and cleans up pending bridges list.

methods.name: configureDevice
methods.description: Configures a device based on pending bridge info, creates resources, and starts monitoring.

methods.name: readResource
methods.description: Reads the state of a resource, such as whether a light is on.

methods.name: writeResource
methods.description: Writes a new value to a resource, such as turning a light on or off.

methods.name: lightChangedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a light's state changes; updates resource accordingly.

methods.name: ipAddressChangedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a bridge's IP address changes; updates resource.

methods.name: startMonitoringBridge
methods.description: Begins monitoring a specific bridge for light and IP address changes.

methods.name: deviceRemoved
methods.description: Handles device removal by stopping monitoring.

methods.name: getLight
methods.description: Retrieves a specific light object based on device UUID and endpoint ID.
